time_zone: all timestamps are local standard time (UTC-6), no daylight saving; each row is the 5-minute interval starting at its timestamp
house: single-storey ranch on a concrete slab, built 1985, 165 m2 conditioned floor area
energy: all-electric; a heat pump does the heating and cooling
meter: power_kW = mean whole-house electric demand over the 5-minute interval
thermostat: indoor_temp_C = the thermostat's temperature reading at the end of the interval (0.1 C resolution)
weather_source: Open-Meteo historical weather archive (ERA5-based), hourly values interpolated to 5 minutes; CC BY 4.0
